description: This file defines the Currency class, which manages currency data, conversion rates, and formatting within the Goteo application. It includes methods for setting/getting default currencies, adding new currencies, retrieving currency rates via a Converter, and formatting amounts based on session and currency data.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A class for managing currencies, including setting default currency, adding currencies, retrieving exchange rates, and formatting amounts based on currency data and conversion rates.

methods.name: setConverter
methods.description: Sets the static converter instance used for currency exchange rate retrieval.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Retrieves the current converter instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default currency by its identifier.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default currency in the specified format.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Adds a new currency to the list of available currencies with necessary legacy key compatibilities.

methods.name: setCurrenciesAvailable
methods.description: Replaces current available currencies with a new set.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Lists all currencies in either array or a specified method.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific currency by its code.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all currencies with their current exchange rates.

methods.name: amountFormat
methods.description: Formats an amount in the current currency, optionally reverting or formatting with symbol and decimal/thousand separators.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats an amount with its currency symbol.

methods.name: rate
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate for a specified currency relative to the default currency.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Converts an amount to the base currency using the current rate.

methods.name: amountInverse
methods.description: Converts an amount from the base currency to the specified currency using the current rate.
